units.source_text: “驹姐。”从走廊远处响起了提高尾音的喊声。

en.t: “Miss Koma,” a voice called from far down the corridor, its ending rising in pitch.

units.source_text: 驹子把客栈的小女孩抱进被炉里，一心陪着小女孩玩，直到快晌午，才带着这三岁的小女孩去洗澡。

en.t: Komako lifted the inn’s little girl into the kotatsu and devoted herself to playing with her until nearly noon, when she took the three-year-old girl to bathe.
